name: Ticket Volume by Category

filters.label: Status
filters.options:
Open
Working in Progress
Pending
Waiting for Reply
Resolved
Reopened
Closed

query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(category, ''), 'Uncategorized') AS "Category:Data:220",
    status AS "Status:Data:160",
    priority AS "Priority:Data:100",
    COUNT(*) AS "Tickets:Int:90",
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL
        THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, opened_at, first_response_at) / 3600.0
        ELSE NULL END), 1) AS "Avg First Response Hours:Float:160",
    MIN(DATE(opened_at)) AS "First Opened:Date:120",
    MAX(DATE(opened_at)) AS "Latest Opened:Date:120"
FROM `tabSupport Ticket`
WHERE
    (IFNULL(%(from_date)s, '') = '' OR opened_at >= %(from_date)s)
    AND (IFNULL(%(to_date)s, '') = '' OR opened_at < DATE_ADD(%(to_date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
    AND (IFNULL(%(status)s, '') = '' OR status = %(status)s)
    AND (IFNULL(%(priority)s, '') = '' OR priority = %(priority)s)
GROUP BY
    COALESCE(NULLIF(category, ''), 'Uncategorized'), status, priority
ORDER BY Tickets DESC, Category, Status
